goal: Implement milestone R1 from contracts/runtime-plan.json: the ZeroAI CLI interception layer, workspace binding, provider/BYOK registry, ZeroIntercept, Intent Compiler, and authorized context envelope.
invariants: Every prompt is intercepted before provider dispatch.
ZeroAI determines which context is disclosed to a provider.
Provider credentials are never committed to the repository.
R1 does not grant models direct OS, Git, database, browser, network, deployment, or external-tool execution authority.
R2 worktree mutation/execution behavior is not implemented by weakening R1 controls.
Certification-state schema changes are limited to BLOCKED_INFRASTRUCTURE support.
Only .env.example may change for documented environment variable names; runtime secret values remain protected.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running zeroai inside a Git repository starts an interactive ZeroAI session bound to that repository and workspace.
A natural-language prompt is intercepted and compiled into a typed execution intent before any provider adapter is invoked.
evidence: unit test proving interceptor precedes provider invocation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Provider/BYOK configuration resolves through secure credential references and does not persist plaintext provider secrets in the repository.
Only ZeroAI-authorized repo, memory, workspace, and policy context is present in the provider request envelope.
Existing architecture certification, typecheck, tests, and production build remain green.

prohibitedChanges: No plaintext provider API keys in repo files.
No destructive changes to a user's working tree.
No skipping ahead to R2/R3/R4 by bypassing R1 acceptance criteria.
